header: Cards that link each audience to its page
lead: Use it as the entry point to a set of pages. Each card names a role or a sector and links to a page with the details.

cases.title: The whole card is the link
cases.description: One tab stop per card. The title names the link for screen readers.

cases.title: The description stays short
cases.description: Two lines at most. The details belong on the linked page.

cases.title: Two to four columns
cases.description: The same grid as the feature grid, so pages that use both stay consistent.

cases.title: A see-all button
cases.description: For sets with more than nine cards, link to a full directory.
